text: In all N=16 seeds the distance margin levels off at about 0.54-0.67 by steps 25-30, and accel_step rises steadily from step 30 to step 90 after that. Is accel_step formation downstream of distance formation? For example, does the accel_step rise survive regressing distance out of the target at steps 30-90, and does delaying distance formation also delay accel_step?
